target_source: EWAS Atlas bulk, colorectal cancer (no p filter; as reported by source studies)
target_description: listed vs matched unlisted CpG, 20 independent matching draws
background_sampling: 1 unlisted CpG per listed CpG in the same stratum, no replacement, <=2,000 pairs/draw; unlisted != unassociated
matching_covariates: chromosome x CpG context x gene region x core-breadth decile; Infinium probe type NOT matched (balance reported); GC / TSS distance NOT matched
split_strategy: GroupKFold(5) by chromosome; pooled out-of-fold AUC
representation_variant: campaign context_only_256 (18 dense context cols, SVD256)
classifier_probe: StandardScaler (fold-wise) + LogisticRegression C=1 (fixed, no tuning)
ci_definition: 95% percentile of 10,000-replicate seed-mixture bootstrap (draw 1 of 20 matching seeds, resample matched pairs within chromosome); includes matching-draw variability
notes: between_seed_sd=0.0100504664813102; seed range [0.506650875, 0.53661775]. regulatory_histone_dnase_v1 and native-DNase/histone arms NOT included in this run. AUPRC not computed. Matching uses functional-store dense columns (inputs of the legacy functional/context arms).

target_source: UCSC cpgIslandExt hg38 (island = inside; shore <=2 kb; shelf 2-4 kb; open sea >4 kb)
target_description: one-vs-rest CpG context class 'island' of a CpG
background_sampling: ALL other CpGs of the annotated universe (no sampling, unmatched)
split_strategy: StratifiedKFold(5, shuffle, random_state=17): RANDOM locus split (neighbouring CpGs fall in train and test)
classifier_probe: LogisticRegressionCV (default inner CV, L2) on z-scored embedding; AUROC = mean of 5 fold AUROCs
notes: SOURCE-RETENTION check for functional_annotations_pca (dense cols 0-3 are its inputs); w.r.t. regulatory_histone_dnase_v1 island is not an input (frozen table cell I) but is biologically coupled to H3K4me3/DNase promoter marks. Island status is sequence-composition defined (PARTIAL for sequence arms). Threshold metrics (accuracy/F1/precision/recall) are at p=0.5 under class imbalance. AUPRC not computed.
